wb: Wb is a unit of magnetic flux equal to 100,000,000 maxwells.
Wb means the same as weber.
wbc: WBC is blood cells that engulf and digest bacteria and fungi.
WBC means the same as leukocyte or leucocyte or white blood cell.
wbn: WbN is the compass point that is one point north of due west.
WbN means the same as west by north.
wbs: WbS is the compass point that is one point south of due west.
WbS means the same as west by south.
